# Simple Data Analysis v6.0.10

> Fast DuckDB-powered TypeScript library for tabular, geospatial, vector, AI, Google Cloud Storage, Google Sheets, and data visualization workflows on Node.js.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis/v6.0.10/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [SimpleDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis/v6.0.10/docs/classes/SimpleDB.md): SimpleDB class
- [SimpleTable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis/v6.0.10/docs/classes/SimpleTable.md): SimpleTable class
